title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Coin Knows What You Did
description: Rhonda reads the money-and-luck horoscopes while a single heads-up penny creeps closer to the listener, sign by sign. Ronnie keeps calling it good luck. It is the down payment, and it is counting.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars... with Rhonda. Rhonda, it's money and luck week. Folks could use a little luck.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: There is no luck, Ronnie. There is only the coin. <p:0.3> And it is counting.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. You will find a coin on the sidewalk, heads-up. You will think it is luck. It is the down payment.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, free money! That's a nice start, that's a win for Aries.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. Your savings are fine. The coin is not in the account. It is in your pocket now. It was not there this morning.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] Okay, wait, how did it get in the pocket?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. Do not check your balance at three eleven. The number will be correct. <p:0.3> That is the problem.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Correct is bad now? Rhonda, correct is supposed to be the good one.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Look down, Ronnie. <p:0.3> You have been holding the coin since the show began.
